breakdown.description: A/2<111>, but the consistent perfect-dislocation Burgers vector in FCC is a/2<110>.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification continued using b = a/2 <111> instead of correcting it to the proper FCC perfect dislocation Burgers vector a/2 <110>. The ground truth requires using <110>, which gives |b| = (a/2)√2 ≈ 0.255 nm, but the agent calculated |b| using <111> direction (√3), yielding ≈ 0.312 nm. The error was not corrected.
